questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Is Asked

This question assesses practical ability to design reusable CI/CD pipelines with templates, conditional logic, and enterprise-grade configurations in an Azure environment.

## Key Concepts

- **Azure DevOps YAML templates** for modular, maintainable pipeline design
- **Conditional deployment workflows** for PR validation versus production releases
- **Azure App Configuration** feature flags enabling controlled canary rollouts
- **Azure Key Vault** integration for secure secret and credential management
- **App Service deployment slots** for zero-downtime releases with traffic splitting
- **Health checks** with logging to Azure Monitor for operational visibility

## Code Example

### Main Pipeline (`azure-pipelines.yml`)

```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
      - 'release/*'

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  - group: microservice-vars
  - template: templates/variables/service-names.yml

stages:
  - template: templates/stages/validation.yml
    parameters:
      services: $[ dependencies.prep.outputs['Setup.services'] ]

  - template: templates/stages/build.yml
    parameters:
      services:
        - name: service-a
          appName: $(service-a-app-name)
          slotName: staging
        - name: service-b
          appName: $(service-b-app-name)
          slotName: staging

  - template: templates/stages/deploy.yml
    parameters:
      condition: eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')
      services:
        - name: service-a
          appName: $(service-a-app-name)
          canaryPercentage: 10
        - name: service-b
          appName: $(service-b-app-name)
          canaryPercentage: 10
```

### Validation Stage Template (`templates/stages/validation.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

stages:
  - stage: Validation
    displayName: PR Validation
    condition: eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')
    jobs:
      - job: RunTestsAndLint
        displayName: Test and Lint
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: Setup .NET SDK
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.0.x'

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/test.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/${{ service.name }}

          - template: ../jobs/lint.yml
            parameters:
              services: ${{ parameters.services }}
```

### Build Stage Template (`templates/stages/build.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

stages:
  - stage: Build
    displayName: Build Services
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        displayName: Build and Publish
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: Fetch Secrets
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
              KeyVaultName: '$(keyvault-name)'
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/build.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                appName: ${{ service.appName }}
                workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/${{ service.name }}
```

### Deploy Stage Template (`templates/stages/deploy.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object
  - name: condition
    type: string
    default: ''

stages:
  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: Deploy to Production
    condition: ${{ parameters.condition }}
    jobs:
      - job: DeployServices
        displayName: Deploy All Services
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: Enable Canary Feature Flag
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
              Action: 'Update feature flags'
              Feature Flag Name: 'CanaryRelease'
              Connection: 'app-config-connection'

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/deploy.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                appName: ${{ service.appName }}
                canaryPercentage: ${{ service.canaryPercentage }}

          - template: ../jobs/health-check.yml
            parameters:
              services: ${{ parameters.services }}
```

### Build Job Template (`templates/jobs/build.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: appName
    type: string
  - name: workingDirectory
    type: string

jobs:
  - job: Build_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Build ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    steps:
      - script: |
          dotnet build -c Release
        workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}
        displayName: Build Service

      - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
        displayName: Publish Service
        inputs:
          command: 'publish'
          publishWebProjects: true
          arguments: -c Release -o $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
          workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}

      - publish: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
        artifact: ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
        displayName: Publish Artifacts
```

### Test Job Template (`templates/jobs/test.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: workingDirectory
    type: string

jobs:
  - job: Test_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Run Tests - ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    steps:
      - task: UseDotNet@2
        inputs:
          packageType: 'sdk'
          version: '8.0.x'

      - script: dotnet test --logger trx --results-directory $(TestResultsDirectory)
        workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}
        displayName: Run Unit Tests

      - task: PublishTestResults@2
        displayName: Publish Test Results
        inputs:
          testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
          testResultsFiles: '$(TestResultsDirectory)/*.trx'
          failOnMinTestsNotMet: true
          minTestsNotMetImpact: 'testFailureThreshold'
```

### Lint Job Template (`templates/jobs/lint.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

jobs:
  - job: Lint
    displayName: Run Linting
    steps:
      - task: UseDotNet@2
        inputs:
          packageType: 'sdk'
          version: '8.0.x'

      - script: |
          dotnet tool install --global dotnet-format || true
          for dir in ${{ join(' ', parameters.services.*.name) }}; do
            dotnet-format --folder $dir --verify-no-changes || exit 1
          done
        displayName: Run Linter
```

### Deploy Job Template (`templates/jobs/deploy.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: appName
    type: string
  - name: canaryPercentage
    type: number
    default: 0

jobs:
  - deployment: Deploy_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Deploy ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    environment: 'production-${{ parameters.serviceName }}'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
            - task: AzureWebApp@1
              displayName: Deploy to App Service Slot
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
                appType: 'webApp'
                appName: ${{ parameters.appName }}
                slotName: 'production'
                package: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
                deploymentMethod: 'auto'

            - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
              displayName: Set Canary Traffic
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
                Action: 'Update feature flags'
                Feature Flag Name: '${{ parameters.serviceName }}.CanaryPercentage'
                Connection: 'app-config-connection'
                Value: ${{ parameters.canaryPercentage }}

            - script: |
                az webapp traffic-routing set --name ${{ parameters.appName }} --distribution ${{ parameters.serviceName }}.prod=90;${{ parameters.serviceName }}.canary=${{ parameters.canaryPercentage }}
              displayName: Configure Traffic Routing
```

### Health Check Job Template (`templates/jobs/health-check.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

jobs:
  - job: HealthCheck
    displayName: Verify Service Health
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
      - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
        - script: |
            response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://${{ service.appName }}.azurewebsites.net/health)
            if [ "$response" -ne 200 ]; then
              echo "Health check failed for ${{ service.name }}"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "${{ service.name }} health check passed"
          displayName: Health Check - ${{ service.name }}

      - task: AzureCLI@2
        displayName: Log to Azure Monitor
        inputs:
          azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
          scriptType: 'bash'
          scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
          inlineScript: |
            az monitor app-insights query --app ${{ parameters.services[0].appName }} --analytics-query "requests | where success == true | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)"
```

## Template Structure Overview

```
templates/
├── stages/
│   ├── validation.yml      # PR: test + lint only
│   ├── build.yml           # Build and package services
│   └── deploy.yml          # Production deployment with canary
├── jobs/
│   ├── build.yml           # Compile and publish artifacts
│   ├── test.yml            # Run unit tests
│   ├── lint.yml            # Code quality checks
│   ├── deploy.yml          # Deploy to App Service with traffic routing
│   └── health-check.yml    # Verify endpoints and log to Monitor
└── variables/
    └── service-names.yml   # Per-environment service configuration
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates end-to-end experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) deployments, GitOps workflows, and policy-driven governance in enterprise environments.

## Key Concepts
- **AKS & Helm**: Multi-service architecture with isolated namespaces per service
- **GitOps**: Argo CD reconciliation for declarative infrastructure
- **Security**: Azure Key Vault secrets with Managed Identity for authentication
- **Configuration**: Azure App Configuration for environment-specific values
- **Progressive Delivery**: Canary deployments, drift detection, and automated rollback
- **Governance**: Azure Policy and OPA for policy enforcement
- **Compliance**: SBOM generation for supply chain security
- **Observability**: Azure Monitor for health checks and logging
- **Change Management**: Manual approvals and auto-rollback strategies

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps Pipeline - Multi-Service AKS Deployment
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  helmRepo: 'oci://acr.azurecr.io/helm-charts'
  aksCluster: 'aks-production'
  rg: 'rg-aks-prod'

stages:
  - stage: Build
    displayName: 'Build & Package Services'
    jobs:
      - job: BuildServices
        steps:
          - task: Docker@4
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: 'acrConnection'
              repository: '$(serviceName)'
              command: 'buildAndPush'
          - task: HelmDeploy@0
            inputs:
              command: 'package'
              chartPath: 'charts/$(serviceName)'
              version: '$(Build.BuildNumber)'
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests candidates' ability to design complex, real-world deployments spanning multiple regions, tenants, and policy controls, including traffic management, drift detection, automated rollback, and observability.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant namespaces in AKS
- Blue/green rollout strategies across primary and DR clusters
- Argo Rollouts or Istio for traffic shifting
- Azure Policy + OPA gating mechanisms
- Per-tenant feature flags via App Configuration
- Drift checks against ARM templates
- Automated rollback and Azure Monitor Logs integration

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  none

pr: none

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: templates
      type: git
      name: $(azureDevOpsOrg)/pipeline-templates
      ref: main

variables:
  - group: tenant-config
  - name: aksPrimaryCluster
    value: "aks-primary-weu"
  - name: aksDrCluster
    value: "aks-dr-neu"
  - name: appConfigName
    value: "appconfig-$(env)"

stages:
  - stage: Validate_Templates
    displayName: "Validate ARM Templates"
    jobs:
      - job: Drift_Check
        displayName: "Per-Tenant Drift Detection"
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceManagerTemplateDeployment@3
            displayName: "Validate ARM Template Syntax"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              location: $(location)
              csmFile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/arm/tenant-template.json
              overrideParameters: "-tenantId $(tenantId)"
              deploymentMode: Validation
          - script: |
              echo "Checking drift against baseline..."
              az resource group show --name $(tenantResourceGroup) \
                --query "properties.templateValidationResults" || true
            displayName: "Detect Configuration Drift"

  - stage: Build_Tenant_Artifacts
    displayName: "Build Container Images"
    jobs:
      - job: Build_and_Push
        displayName: "Build per-Tenant Image"
        steps:
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: "Build API Image"
            inputs:
              command: build
              dockerfile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile
              arguments: |
                --build-arg TENANT_ID=$(tenantId)
                --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(Build.BuildNumber)
              imageName: "$(containerRegistry)/tenant-api-$(tenantId):$(Build.BuildNumber)"
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: "Push to ACR"
            inputs:
              command: push
              containerRegistry: $(containerRegistry)
              imageName: "$(containerRegistry)/tenant-api-$(tenantId):$(Build.BuildNumber)"

  - stage: Deploy_Primary_Cluster
    displayName: "Deploy to Primary (WEU)"
    dependsOn: [Build_Tenant_Artifacts, Validate_Templates]
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_To_Primary
        displayName: "Deploy with Argo Rollout"
        environment: "aks-primary-$(tenantId)"
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - checkout: self
                - task: KubernetesManifest@0
                  displayName: "Apply Argo Rollout CRD"
                  inputs:
                    action: create
                    kubernetesServiceConnection: $(aksPrimaryConnection)
                    namespace: "tenant-$(tenantId)"
                    manifests: |
                      $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/k8s/rollout.yaml
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: "Pause Rollout at 30%"
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: bash
                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
                    inlineScript: |
                      kubectl argo rollouts pause tenant-api \
                        -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                        --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
                - task: AzurePolicy@0
                  displayName: "Azure Policy Compliance Check"
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    definitionId: "/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/tenant-config-policy"
                    assignmentId: "/subscriptions/$(subId)/resourceGroups/$(tenantResourceGroup)/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments/tenant-policy"
                - bash: |
                    curl -s https://opa-endpoint:8181/v1/data/tenant/promotion \
                      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                      -d @/dev/stdin <<< '{"input": {"tenant": "$(tenantId)", "env": "$(env)"}}'
                  name: opa_gate_check
                  displayName: "OPA Policy Gate"

  - stage: Traffic_Shift_30_70
    displayName: "Traffic Shift 30/70"
    dependsOn: Deploy_Primary_Cluster
    condition: succeeded('opa_gate_check')
    jobs:
      - job: Shift_Traffic
        steps:
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 30 \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
            displayName: "Set Traffic to 30/70"
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            displayName: "Monitor Health Metrics"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroup: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              alertRules:
                - alertName: "HighErrorRate"
                  expression: "requests_error_rate > 0.05"
                  severity: warning
          - bash: |
              sleep 300
              echo "Monitoring for 5 minutes before proceeding..."
            displayName: "Smoke Test Period"

  - stage: Traffic_Shift_100
    displayName: "Full Promotion 100%"
    dependsOn: Traffic_Shift_30_70
    jobs:
      - job: Full_Promotion
        steps:
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 100 \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
              kubectl argo rollouts promote tenant-api \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId)
            displayName: "Promote to 100% Traffic"

  - stage: Deploy_DR_Cluster
    displayName: "Deploy to DR (NEU)"
    dependsOn: Traffic_Shift_100
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_To_DR
        displayName: "DR Cluster Sync"
        environment: "aks-dr-$(tenantId)"
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - bash: |
                    kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 0 \
                      -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                      --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig-dr
                    kubectl apply -f $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/k8s/rollout.yaml \
                      --namespace tenant-$(tenantId) \
                      --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig-dr
                  displayName: "Initialize DR with Zero Traffic"

  - stage: Auto_Rollback_Check
    displayName: "Rollback Monitoring"
    dependsOn:
      - Traffic_Shift_30_70
      - Traffic_Shift_100
    jobs:
      - job: Monitor_And_Rollback
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: "Configure Rollback Triggers"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: bash
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor metrics alert create \
                  --name "rollback-$(tenantId)" \
                  --resource-group $(tenantResourceGroup) \
                  --condition "count > 10 where errorCode >= 500" \
                  --action apiUrl=https://v3.rollouts.azrefficient.net/api/rollback \
                    -n "aut rollback-hook"
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts get rollout tenant-api \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) -w &
              ROLLOUT_PID=$!
              sleep 600
              if ps -p $ROLLOUT_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                kubectl argo rollouts abort tenant-api \
                  -n tenant-$(tenantId)
                echo "Auto-rollback triggered due to degraded health"
              fi
            displayName: "Health-Based Rollback Monitor"

  - stage: Log_To_Monitor
    displayName: "Azure Monitor Logging"
    dependsOn: [Deploy_Primary_Cluster, Traffic_Shift_30_70, Traffic_Shift_100, Deploy_DR_Cluster]
    jobs:
      - job: Publish_Logs
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: "Send Pipeline Metrics to Log Analytics"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: bash
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace $(logAnalyticsWorkspace) \
                  --analytics-query "\
                    PipelineLogs | where PipelineName == '$(PipelineName)' \
                    and TenantId == '$(tenantId)' | summarize \
                    count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Status"
          - task: PublishToAzureMonitorLogs@1
            displayName: "Export Full Pipeline Logs"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              ResourceGroup: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              logs:
                - name: TenantDeploymentLogs
                  type: Generic
                  source: pipeline

## Failure Modes and Guardrails

| Failure Mode | Detection | Guardrail |
|--------------|-----------|-----------|
| ARM template drift | Azure Resource Manager validation | Block deployment until reconciled |
| Policy non-compliance | Azure Policy evaluation | OPA gate prevents promotion |
| Traffic shift error rate spike | Log Analytics alert | Auto-rollback via Argo Rollouts |
| DR cluster sync failure | Health endpoint check | Fail deployment, notify via Teams |
| Feature flag mismatch | App Config sync validation | Pause rollout, require manual override |
| Namespace quota exceeded | AKS resource metrics | Pre-deployment quota check |

## Required Integrations

1. **Azure App Configuration**: Store per-tenant feature flags with key vault references for secrets
2. **Azure Container Registry**: Host per-tenant container images with tags
3. **Azure Monitor / Application Insights**: End-to-end observability and alerting
4. **Argo Rollouts**: Kubernetes-native progressive delivery with automated rollback
5. **OPA Gatekeeper**: Policy enforcement for tenant isolation and resource limits
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the ability to architect scalable, multi-tenant SaaS solutions with proper resource isolation, governance controls, and operational automation.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant isolation in AKS using dedicated namespaces and Helm releases
- Ephemeral resource lifecycle management with cost governance via Azure Cost Management budgets
- Azure Policy gates and drift detection for compliance enforcement
- Automated resource cleanup and comprehensive monitoring via Azure Monitor and Container Insights

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  paths:
    include:
      - tenants/*
  branches:
    include:
      - tenant-creation

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: TenantProvision
        steps:
          - bash: |
              TENANT_ID="$(tenant-id)"
              az aks create -g $(rg-name) -n "ns-$TENANT_ID" --skip-subnet-creation
              az aks get-credentials -g $(rg-name) -n "ns-$TENANT_ID" --file ./kubeconfig
              helm upgrade --install tenant-$TENANT_ID ./charts/tenant \
                --namespace $TENANT_ID --create-namespace \
                --set tenant.id=$TENANT_ID
              az sql server create -g $(rg-name) -s "sqld-$TENANT_ID" \
                -p $(key-vault-name) --admin-password
              az sql db create -g $(rg-name) -s "sqld-$TENANT_ID" \
                -n tenantdb --serverless-capacity
            displayName: Provision tenant resources

  - stage: Test
    jobs:
      - job: E2ETests
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(service-conn)
              script: |
                TENANT_ID="$(tenant-id)"
                kubectl config use-context "ns-$TENANT_ID"
                pytest tests/e2e/ --tenant-id=$TENANT_ID

  - stage: GateProd
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCompliance
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@1
            inputs:
              policyDefinition: /providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policySetDefinitions/tenant-compliance
          - task: AzureCostManagement@1
            inputs:
              budgetName: "budget-$(tenant-id)"
              action: Check
              stopDuration: 1h

  - stage: Cleanup
    condition: eq(variables['tenant.status'], 'deleted')
    jobs:
      - job: DeleteResources
        steps:
          - bash: |
              TENANT_ID="$(tenant-id)"
              az aks delete -g $(rg-name) -n "ns-$TENANT_ID" --yes
              az sql server delete -g $(rg-name) -s "sqld-$TENANT_ID" --yes
              az keyvault secret delete -n "db-$TENANT_ID"
            displayName: Cleanup tenant resources
```
